```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(targets)
row_id <- params$row_id
pandoc_to <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")
is_html <- !is.null(pandoc_to) && pandoc_to == "html"
```

# Simulation `r row_id`: Drift Analysis

```{r}
#| echo: false

knitr::kable(tar_read(tables, branches = row_id)[[1]])
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

if (is_html) {
  tar_read(dygraphs, branches = row_id)[[1]]
} else {
  print(tar_read(charts, branches = row_id)[[1]])
}
```
